about_the_game:
We’ll be honest — Coffee Rush isn’t as advanced as some of our other games. But it’s got heart, and it was made to poke fun at something most of us have felt: the more coffee we drink, the faster we work… right?

In this chaotic office satire, you’re just another overworked employee trying to impress the boss, survive the day, and maybe earn a slightly better office. Or at least not get fired.

Controls

  • WASD to move

  • Spacebar to jump

  • Shift to drink coffee and sprint for a short time

Here’s the grind

  • Coffee doesn’t last forever — you’ll need to find more. Cups appear randomly when coworkers leave them behind

  • Other employees may try to start conversations that slow you down

  • Slip on coffee puddles or get hit with books your coworkers think you need to read

  • Your main job is to find the printer room, collect papers, and return them to your desk

If you’ve delivered enough papers, you can either go see the boss and maybe get a new office — or keep trying to get more papers and earn a spot on the leaderboard. But you're always on the clock. Fall behind, and you're fired.

short_description: Race through the office in this chaotic coffee-fueled satire. Find printer paper, dodge chatty coworkers, avoid spills, and grab abandoned coffee cups to boost your speed. Deliver enough to meet the boss or keep going to hit the leaderboard — but hurry, or you're fired!
